scripts.text: We were afraid that Odin and Heimdall would punish us because, well, in their eyes we disgraced the goddess.
scripts.translation: 我们怕奥丁和海姆达尔会惩罚我们，因为在他们看来，我们让女神蒙羞了。

scripts.text: Oh course, they never would have been angered if it weren't for Loki's trickery.
scripts.translation: 当然，要不是洛基使诈，他们也不会发怒。

scripts.text: We loved Freya so much that we decided to hide ourselves beneath the path that she walked. To be as close to any trace of her as we could.
scripts.translation: 我们深爱芙蕾雅，便藏在她走过的路下，尽可能靠近她留下的痕迹。

scripts.text: Brisingamen is our masterpiece, a necklace we forged for Freya. Even if we tried making it again, I doubt it would be as good.
scripts.translation: 女神项链是我们为芙蕾雅打造的杰作。就算重新制作，恐怕也比不上原作。

scripts.text: It looked perfect on Freya. Very difficult to create jewelry that actually enhances the attractiveness of the goddess of beauty.
scripts.translation: 项链戴在芙蕾雅身上再合适不过。要做出能衬托美之女神魅力的首饰，可不容易。

scripts.text: Perhaps our greatest reward was that beautiful smile of satisfaction she gave us when that we gave her that necklace. We loved her so.
scripts.translation: 也许我们最大的回报，就是送上项链时，她脸上那满足的笑容。我们实在太爱她了。

scripts.text: Is it that wrong for dwarves to love a goddess? Perhaps we were punished because the gods, even Odin, loved her as well.
scripts.translation: 矮人爱上女神，难道有错吗？也许众神，连奥丁都爱她，所以我们才受惩罚。

scripts.text: In any case, we've never seen the true Brisingamen again. But something very similar to it can be created...
scripts.translation: 总之，我们再也没见过真正的女神项链。不过，倒是能打造一件极为相似的仿制品...

scripts.text: You'll need materials that have been graced by the goddess' presense. Traces of the goddess in the earth, water and the wind.
scripts.translation: 你需要沾染过女神气息的材料，也就是她在大地、水与风中留下的痕迹。

scripts.text: And if the Brisingamen is recreated, the power of a god will be in the hands of a human. That human could be you!
scripts.translation: 若能重新打造女神项链，神力就会落入人类手中。那个人或许就是你！

scripts.text: Poor Dvalin is sleeping under the path in the East. Once there, you'll feel the scent the goddess.
scripts.translation: 可怜的德瓦林睡在东方那条路下面。到了那里，你会闻到女神的气息。

scripts.text: I can't remember where the others are sleeping, but you cannot forget these words...
scripts.translation: 我不记得其他人睡在哪里了，但你不能忘记这些话...

scripts.text: Get lost before Loki and Heimdall find out I've awakened! Now hurry, find Dvalin, and wake him up!
scripts.translation: 趁洛基和海姆达尔还没发现我醒来，快走！赶紧去找到德瓦林，把他叫醒！

scripts.text: Oh, finally all of us have awakened! Now, the power of the goddess can be retrieved from the earth, water and the wind!
scripts.translation: 啊，我们终于全都醒了！现在可以从大地、水与风中取回女神留下的力量了！

scripts.text: It makes sense that you want a replica of Brisingamen for its power. But remember, we originally made Brisingamen as a necklace fit for a goddess.
scripts.translation: 你想要一件能借助神力的仿制品，倒也不奇怪。不过要记住，我们当初打造女神项链，是要献给女神的。

scripts.text: Some might say that we seduced Freya with the necklace, but we really loved her with all of our hearts.
scripts.translation: 或许有人会说，我们是用项链诱惑了芙蕾雅，但我们对她的爱确实出自真心。

scripts.translation: 是阿尔弗里克派我来叫醒你的！

scripts.text: Did you just say Alfrik sent you? How do you know my brother?!
scripts.translation: 你刚说是阿尔弗里克派你来的？你怎么会认识我哥哥？！

scripts.text: Even if it's not the original, I'm sure it can possess power comparable to the real thing. Yes...
scripts.translation: 仿制品...就算不是原件，想必也能有差不多的力量。没错...

scripts.text: It's no use trying to predict the future, but I can't help but wonder what would mankind do with the power of the gods?
scripts.translation: 未来无法预料，但我还是忍不住想：人类会如何运用神的力量？

scripts.text: We hid ourselves near traces of Freya. The path where I am staying is one that my goddess has walked through.
scripts.translation: 我们躲在芙蕾雅留下的痕迹附近。我藏身之处，正是女神曾经走过的路。

scripts.text: The air that quietly drifts here holds her fragrant scent. You can use this wind to borrow her power.
scripts.translation: 这里的空气静静流转，带着她芬芳的气息。你可以借风之力，感受她留下的力量。

scripts.text: no special love for the gods or giants. But I am intrigued by you humans. Your race is one of both love and hatred, life and destruction.
scripts.translation: 对其他神明或巨人并无特别好感。不过，人类倒令我着迷。你们既能相爱相恨，也能创造与毁灭。

scripts.text: Go now and seek Berling. He is sleeping near a river linked to Mount Mjolnir. Travel West to find the river were Freya's Teardrops have fallen.

scripts.translation: 若水之幻影向你出题，就回答它。答案就是奥丁加在我们女神身上的惩罚。
